title: Direct Proportionality Between Variables s and t
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: The variable s is directly proportional to t, and s = 25 when t = 75. Determine the value of t when s = 60.

steps.title: Write the Direct Proportionality Equation
steps.explanation: Saying that s is directly proportional to t means there exists a non-zero constant of proportionality k such that s = kt.
steps.why: Direct proportionality is defined by a constant ratio s / t = k.

steps.title: Determine the Constant of Proportionality k
steps.explanation: Substitute the given pair s = 25 and t = 75 into s = kt and divide by 75 to find k = 1/3.
steps.why: A single known non-zero pair (t, s) uniquely determines the slope k of the proportional relationship.

steps.title: Solve for t When s = 60
steps.explanation: Substitute s = 60 into s = (1/3)t and multiply both sides by 3 to obtain t = 180.
steps.why: Multiplying both sides by 3 isolates the unknown variable t.
